## 2024-05-26 - [Avoid Linting Side-Effects in PRs]
**Learning:** Running `pnpm lint` in the `server-nest` project inherently runs with the `--fix` flag, which applies thousands of lines of global formatting changes to unrelated files, polluting the PR and causing code review nitpicks. Also, a local `pnpm install` may generate a `pnpm-lock.yaml` file that shouldn't be committed if it wasn't there originally.
**Action:** Always run `git status` and use targeted git checkout/reset strategies to revert unintended formatting changes across the codebase. Remove auto-generated lock files (`git restore --staged server-nest/pnpm-lock.yaml && rm server-nest/pnpm-lock.yaml`) before committing. Ensure the PR only contains exactly the lines you intentionally modified for the optimization.
